name: b_ducks_only
description: Ducks only: one small duck off tape in each of the 5 numbered zones (5x). Nothing else is touched; Botguy stays at his start position, which earns Base 1 under the literal written rule (unmoved_botguy_scores_base). Result is 30 under the default ruling, 25 if unmoved Botguy earns nothing, 20 if zone 5 does not count for the multiplier. Shows that the multiplier is only as good as the subtotal it multiplies.
